author: Jason Stys
summary: Inspect hash-validated game replays with timeline scrubbing, terrain/line-of-sight state and independent default-bot diagnostics in bounded offline HTML.
rationale: Makes game behavior review portable while distinguishing recorded hindsight from independent replay decisions.
limitations: Fictional turn-based game only; no real-world tracking, targeting or live control.
Default-bot diagnostics do not reconstruct the recording policy; the viewer does not rerun the engine or authenticate mutable files.
Inputs are bounded to 128 commands, 16 avatars, 32x32 static cells, 1 MiB import and 8 MiB JSON.
Unity stub compilation is not Unity Editor/PlayMode validation; the upgraded source is not a newly published native game build.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
